issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement labels the class as 'Course' (lines showing 'class Course {') while the rest of the exercise, the template, and the solution use the class name 'Lecture'. This naming mismatch between the UML and the provided code can confuse students about which class they are expected to implement and refer to in their code.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML diagram in the problem statement to use the class name 'Lecture' instead of 'Course' so it matches the textual description, the template code, and the solution. Ensure any references in the UML (attributes and methods) remain the same but are placed under 'class Lecture'.
